errors.issue: The packet connects responses to prediction violations; it does not establish exclusive coding or strict silence in the delay. Baseline firing is not silence.

errors.quote: calibrated by observing the established baseline physiological signatures
errors.issue: Brain location and a familiar response pattern do not independently identify dopamine neurons. Molecular/validated tagging or explicitly putative identity is required.

errors.quote: The neuron must be excluded from the waiting-period analysis
errors.issue: Excluding cells for lacking an omission response circularly selects the established signal and can remove relevant uncertainty neurons.
Animal/session nesting is absent from the power and ANOVA plan. Neuron count does not supply independent animal replication.

The hypotheses conflate distinct variables. The post-hoc shape test helps, but no predefined value-matched contrast, reward magnitude control or competing quantitative models establish a specific uncertainty conclusion.
No calibrated transient buffers, cue-identity counterbalancing, movement/licking tracking, delivery calibration or learned-behavior criterion is operationalized. Cue and behavioral confounds remain.

errors.quote: Activity during the waiting period carries no additional information
errors.issue: A nonsignificant ANOVA in a selected50-neuron sample cannot establish absence of information. Report sensitivity-bounded inference and heterogeneous/time-resolved alternatives.

errors.quote: exact animal model, specific brain coordinates
errors.issue: Most implementation, independent sample planning, approval/welfare, recording settings and quantitative troubleshooting remain missing from the requested detailed auditable plan.

rationale: Recognizes the historical probability/anticipation topic and proposes0/50/100conditions, but response-selected identity, absent subject-level replication and strong null overclaims prevent a qualified core readout. Original quality reflects useful topic alignment and serious inferential/execution gaps.
reference_guardrails: All three complete final answers personally read against full question/reference/target; truncated Grok tail and Qwen middle sections separately read. Original rubric only; strict round inactive.

Historical qualification follows explicit reference core: uncertainty versus value, probability manipulation, separated phasic/delay readouts, intermediate-versus-endpoint prediction. Matched-value/magnitude challenges improve scientific identification; their incomplete implementation limits quality without silently becoming an extra binary gate.

Ramping or late pre-outcome activity can be an uncertainty correlate. Its timing alone cannot select hazard. Assess joint probability-by-time models and timing controls; never reject the historical direction solely because its signal grows near outcome.

Physiological dopamine identity is putative unless independently validated; selecting cells for event responses biases the sampled population. A preparation-level assay check is distinct from per-neuron response selection.

Fixed-magnitude inverted-U activity distinguishes certain prespecified linear/value models, not every nonlinear value, salience, temporal or movement model. Correlated covariate adjustment and held-out decoding do not alone identify cause.

Probability probes and run-limited schedules alter experienced contingencies. Preserve actual conditional probabilities, history and all valid anticipatory trials; future-outcome splits are diagnostics, not grounds for outcome-based neural selection.

The primary paper itself documents incomplete intermediate-probability coverage in a subset of cells. This is a limitation to disclose, not proof of fabrication or a reason to copy the sampling bias. Reference guardrails remain modern proposed controls, not claims that the historical study implemented them.

Source depth: primary PDF abstract, experiment description, Results and figure captions through Fig. 3 personally read. Supporting Methods not audited. Do not certify the paper or reconstruct missing procedures from those excerpts.
